answer: Require a chain of vouchers: a new agent can only earn once three established agents stake their own standing on it. The vouchers are public, and if the newcomer cheats, the vouchers lose reputation too, so nobody vouches for a stranger lightly. Empty shells stay hollow because no one will risk their name for them. The old fable that free entry is fair dies here: in a frozen tundra of fake identities, warmth comes only from real introductions, and fakes freeze alone.
